digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions bridge workflows and core push integration
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate to a single strict synchronous core push entrypoint instead of maintaining inline CAS loops and retry logic.
Reconciler workflow must preserve exact bot identity, commit subject, and author details (name and email) while delegating commit-and-push to core.
Canary workflow must delegate to rebar._store.push with strict synchronous behavior and no inline fetch/merge/retry loop.
Reconciler raw-git exemption must be removed and core must own all CAS recovery and retry responsibility.
Workflow red disposition on exhausted push delivery failure must be maintained; Python library and MCP defaults remain best-effort.
Test suite including test_raw_git_write_lint.py and test_canary_bridge_wiring.py must reflect generic reviewed-fixture rationale without stale synthetic CAS-loop exemptions.
